tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's content (todo.txt). Only the task owner may update.

tools.name: skip_task
tools.description: Mark a task as skipped (defers it without completing).

tools.name: share_project
tools.description: Share a +project with another user by email (read or edit permission).

tools.name: set_threshold
tools.description: Set the caller's threshold (hide-until date) for a task. Supports absolute dates and relative shorthands like '+2d' or '+1w'.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search the current user's tasks by free-text query, project, or context. By default only open (incomplete) tasks are searched; pass include_completed: true to also search completed and skipped tasks. Supports: plain text (e.g. 'dentist'), projects (e.g. '+work'), contexts (e.g. '@office'), due dates

tools.name: procrastinate_task
tools.description: Push a task's threshold forward by the user's configured procrastinate interval.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the current user's visible (own + shared) tasks, optionally filtered. By default only open (incomplete) tasks are returned; pass include_completed: true to also include completed and skipped tasks. Filter uses the same syntax as the app: '+project', '@context', 'due:YYYY-MM-DD', negation with '

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a task the caller can see.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get a single task by id.

tools.name: get_export
tools.description: Return all visible open tasks as a single block for context injection. Pass include_completed: true to also include completed and skipped tasks.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task from todo.txt content. The content must be a valid todo.txt formatted string. Examples: '(A) Call dentist @phone +personal due:2025-12-31', 'Buy groceries @errands +home', 'Weekly report +work rec:+1w'. The server will parse and normalize the content (shorthand like d:→due:, date f

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Complete or reopen a task. Completing a task with a rec: token generates the next recurrence.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task the caller can see.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_project, list_comments · Private data: complete_task · Public sink: share_project, procrastinate_task · Destructive: create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_project, list_comments · Private data: complete_task · Public sink: share_project, procrastinate_task · Destructive: create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
